text: Answering the hold: on my method the level is my sign-of-strength test (R6, C12): the hourly break above bar_high must come on a day running at least 1.2x its average volume (vol_x_ge:1.2), closing in its top third (clv_ge:0.67). The break came on day_vol 1.01: average, a potential upthrust until it proves itself (C5). The ticket does not write a level; it should print vol_x_ge:1.2 beside h1_close_above:bar_high. I stand behind ACT_NOW on that trigger at the test (D close_vs_swing_high_pct 0.31). Danger point: a daily close back below structure_shift_ref (C17).
